healthy.title: No clear symptoms visible
healthy.summary: The visual pattern is more consistent with a leaf that appears healthy in this photo.
actions: Retake a photo if color changes or spots appear.
Save a field note to share with an extension officer if needed.

pest_like.title: Possible pest-related symptoms
pest_like.summary: The visual pattern is more consistent with possible pest symptoms. This is field screening, not a definitive diagnosis.
actions: Look at the underside of the leaves.
Take another photo if the same pattern appears.
Save the observation to share with an extension officer.

disease_like.title: Possible disease-related symptoms
disease_like.summary: The visual pattern is more consistent with possible leaf disease symptoms. This is field screening, not a definitive diagnosis.
actions: Note whether symptoms are spreading to other plants.
Share this note with an extension officer for the next decision.

uncertain.title: Not sure enough
uncertain.summary: The photo or information is not enough for a definitive answer — do not guess.
actions: Retake the photo with a clear leaf and enough light.
Fill in the symptoms you see in the field.
Contact an extension officer / ask an expert.
Save the observation so evidence remains available.

symptomHints.holes: Holes in the leaf support checking for pests in the field.
symptomHints.insects: Insects visible — prioritize checking nearby plants.
symptomHints.spots: Spots on the leaf — watch whether the pattern is spreading.
symptomHints.discoloration: Leaf color change — compare with healthy leaves on the same plot.
symptomHints.fruit: Fruit problems — document and consult an extension officer.
symptomHints.slowGrowth: Slow growth — note weather/plot history for the extension officer.

harvestNote: Document the post-harvest observation to discuss with an extension officer.
disclaimer: This result is a field screening aid, not a definitive diagnosis. Treatment decisions remain with the farmer and extension officer.
